sql:
WITH affected AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT jr.tenant_id
  FROM job_runs jr
  JOIN jobs j ON jr.job_id = j.id
  WHERE j.handler = 'carts.remind'
    AND jr.status = 'failed'
    AND jr.queued_at >= DATE '2025-11-01' AND jr.queued_at < DATE '2025-12-01'
),
groups AS (
  SELECT t.id AS tenant_id,
    CASE WHEN a.tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Affected' ELSE 'Other' END AS group_name
  FROM tenants t
  LEFT JOIN affected a ON a.tenant_id = t.id
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT group_name, COUNT(*) AS tenant_count
  FROM groups
  GROUP BY group_name
),
ticket_counts AS (
  SELECT g.group_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tk.created_at >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND tk.created_at < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS baseline_tickets,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tk.created_at >= DATE '2025-11-01' AND tk.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incident_tickets
  FROM groups g
  LEFT JOIN tickets tk ON tk.tenant_id = g.tenant_id
  GROUP BY g.group_name
)
SELECT
  tc.group_name,
  tcn.tenant_count,
  ROUND(tc.baseline_tickets::numeric / tcn.tenant_count / (61/7.0), 2) AS avg_weekly_tickets_per_tenant_baseline,
  ROUND(tc.incident_tickets::numeric / tcn.tenant_count / (61/7.0), 2) AS avg_weekly_tickets_per_tenant_incident,
  ROUND(
    (((tc.incident_tickets::numeric / tcn.tenant_count) - (tc.baseline_tickets::numeric / tcn.tenant_count))
     / NULLIF(tc.baseline_tickets::numeric / tcn.tenant_count, 0)) * 100
  , 1) AS pct_change
FROM ticket_counts tc
JOIN tenant_counts tcn ON tcn.group_name = tc.group_name
ORDER BY tc.group_name
note: Affected tenants = distinct tenant_ids with a failed job_runs row (via jobs.handler='carts.remind') queued in Nov 2025, per prior reports; this should be exactly the 10 tenants referenced. Periods use created_at on tickets, both exactly 61 days as specified.
